"""Whole request bound probes (development scratch)."""
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/emicro-deps'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/project')
import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('drv','/workspace/project/driver.py')
drv=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(drv)
LIM={'images':16,'cells':262144,'units':1024,'contexts':32768,'connections':4096,'packets':32768,'files':8192}
def job(events): return {'services':[{'name':'A','label':1}],'limits':LIM,'events':events}
def solve(req):
    if not isinstance(req,(bytes,bytearray)): req=json.dumps(req).encode()
    return drv.solve(req)
F=[]
def check(n,g,w):
    if g!=w: F.append('%s: got %r want %r'%(n,g,w))

# 17 stage events
ev=[{'op':'stage','epoch':i+1,'policy':'match(A) allow;'} for i in range(17)]
check('17 stages', solve({'jobs':[job(ev)]}), {'error':'invalid'})
ev=[{'op':'stage','epoch':i+1,'policy':'match(A) allow;'} for i in range(16)]
check('16 stages ok', solve({'jobs':[job(ev)]})['results'][0]['events'][-1].get('error','ok'), 'ok')
# atoms total
pol='match(A) allow;'
ev=[{'op':'stage','epoch':i+1,'policy':pol} for i in range(16)]
check('16x1 atoms', solve({'jobs':[job(ev)]}).get('error','results'), 'results')
# 32768 atoms in one string
atoms=''.join('match(A) allow;' for _ in range(32768))
check('32768 atoms', solve({'jobs':[job([{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':atoms}])]}).get('error','results'), 'results')
atoms=''.join('match(A) allow;' for _ in range(32769))
check('32769 atoms', solve({'jobs':[job([{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':atoms}])]}), {'error':'invalid'})
# path services
atoms=''.join('match(A) allow;' for _ in range(32768))
atoms2=''.join('match(A,B) allow;' for _ in range(32768))
check('65536 path services', solve({'jobs':[job([{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':atoms2}])]}).get('error','results'), 'results')
atoms3=''.join('match(A,B) allow;' for _ in range(32769))
check('65538 path services', solve({'jobs':[job([{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':atoms3}])]}), {'error':'invalid'})
# policy bytes
pad=' '*(8*1024*1024-13)
pol8=('match(A) allow;'+pad)*8
print('policy bytes', len(pol8.encode()))
check('8MiB policy', solve({'jobs':[job([{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':pol8}])]}).get('error','results'), 'results')
pol8b=pol8+' '
check('8MiB+1 policy', solve({'jobs':[job([{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':pol8b}])]}), {'error':'invalid'})
# invalid job excluded from totals
check('invalid job excluded', solve({'jobs':[job([{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':'match(A) allow;'}]),{'bad':1}]}).get('error','results'), 'results')
# events total
ev=[{'op':'inspect'}]*100001
check('100001 events job invalid', solve({'jobs':[job(ev)]}), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
ev=[{'op':'inspect'}]*100000
check('100000 events ok', solve({'jobs':[job(ev)]}).get('error','results'), 'results')
jobs=[job([{'op':'inspect'}]*60000) for _ in range(4)]
check('240000 events over', solve({'jobs':jobs}), {'error':'invalid'})
# integer digit boundary
check('4300 digits', solve(b'{"jobs":[{"services":[],"limits":{},"events":[],"x":' + b'1'*4300 + b'}]}'), {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('4301 digits', solve(b'{"jobs":[{"services":[],"limits":{},"events":[],"x":' + b'1'*4301 + b'}]}'), {'error':'invalid'})
# whitespace forms
check('crlf', solve(b'{"jobs":\r\n[]}'), {'results':[]})
check('other ws', solve(b'{"jobs":[\xc2\xa0]}'), {'error':'invalid'})
print('FAILURES: %d'%len(F))
for f in F: print('  ',f)
PYEOF
